text.title: Competitive Intelligence Failure Modes
text.summary: Antipatterns observed in real deployments of Competitive Intelligence. Each ties a symptom to a root cause and a concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Battlecard cites /pricing/enterprise that returns 404. Citation hallucination: model invents URLs. Fact-checker must HEAD every URL before publishing. Skipping the fact-checker to save tokens on the synthesis pass.
antipattern.root-cause: Synthesizer invents URLs; fact-checker skipped. A single hallucinated feature claim in a battlecard that contradicts the competitor's actual product will be caught by a prospect, not the agent.
antipattern.fix: Run fact-checker on every digest/battlecard; HEAD every URL, reject 4xx.

antipattern.symptom: JS-rendered SPA returns shell page; collector logs 'no change'. Empty-body trap: JS-rendered SPAs return shells; Firecrawl/Jina or Playwright required. Alert on body-length variance > 80%. LLM synthesis when the scraped page is paywalled or JS-rendered and returns an empty body.
antipattern.root-cause: Author used raw curl without JS rendering. Agents invent competitor features from training data when the source page is empty. Always require source citation per claim; reject unsourced assertions.
antipattern.fix: Use Firecrawl / Jina / Playwright; alert on body-length variance > 80%.

antipattern.symptom: Digest re-summarises last week's digest, losing the 'so what'.
antipattern.root-cause: Synthesizer fed digests instead of raw events.
antipattern.fix: Re-ground synthesizer on raw NDJSON events, not previous digests.

antipattern.symptom: Prompt 'Is X a threat?' returns yes 100% of the time.
antipattern.root-cause: Closed yes/no prompt with no evidence floor.
antipattern.fix: Default threat score 1; require evidence accumulation to raise it.

antipattern.symptom: Cookie/paywall: SaaS pricing pages 302-redirect to login. Treat 30x/40x as a signal, not silence. Daily monitors on pricing pages hidden behind "Contact Sales" generating false silence.
antipattern.root-cause: These pages never change for anonymous crawlers. Cross-check G2/Capterra and customer reviews instead for pricing signal.
antipattern.fix: Emit a redirect/status event for every 30x/40x; route pricing signal for gated pages through review sites, not the page itself.

antipattern.symptom: Recency bias: weekly digest over-weights last 2 days. Normalize event volume per day before clustering.
antipattern.root-cause: The synthesizer sees events in arrival order and the most recent ones dominate the context window.
antipattern.fix: Bucket events per day and normalise volume before the synthesizer clusters them.

antipattern.symptom: Stop-words in change detection: HTML diff catches CSS/build-hash churn. Strip script/style tags before fingerprinting.
antipattern.root-cause: Fingerprint computed over the raw HTML instead of the rendered text.
antipattern.fix: Strip script/style tags and asset hashes, fingerprint the visible text only.

antipattern.symptom: Rate limits: wrap fetches with exponential backoff and a circuit breaker. Agent loops on 429 burn tokens.
antipattern.root-cause: Fetch retried inside the agent loop with no backoff and no stop condition.
antipattern.fix: Exponential backoff plus a circuit breaker around every fetch; a tripped breaker emits an error event and stops the loop.

antipattern.symptom: LinkedIn ToS: scraping at scale can ban the company account. Use compliant providers only.
antipattern.root-cause: Hiring signals scraped directly from LinkedIn under the company account.
antipattern.fix: Source hiring signals through compliant providers only (rule source-order-api-rss-scrape).

antipattern.symptom: Trusting win-rate improvement claims (e.g., 16% to 45%) from vendor case studies without auditing methodology.
antipattern.root-cause: Win-rate improvements conflate CI rollout with simultaneous sales enablement and pricing changes. Survivorship bias is severe.
antipattern.fix: Measure CI impact against your own lost deals on the quarterly calibration (rule quarterly-threat-calibration), not against vendor claims.
